source: Public Polymarket Gamma and CLOB REST APIs; read-only capture

historySemantics.priceMeaning: CLOB historical outcome price, decimal probability-like token price; values are not executable bid/ask quotes.

caveats: CLOB prices-history was queried with fidelity=1 for one-minute granularity. Returned observations are close to one minute apart but may be irregular or missing at boundaries; preserve source timestamps.

Moment values are approximations derived from the source match-clock minute and scheduled UTC kickoff. Match-clock minutes are not exact UTC event timestamps; halftime and added time affect second-half conversions.
The histories are historical token prices, not transaction-level trades or a guaranteed executable mid-price. Sparse observations may reflect no update or endpoint sampling behavior.
All three Gamma markets were marked resolved at capture; market state and settlement are read from Polymarket Gamma metadata.
